column1: # NGTS single-telescope photometry CSV file
# Phot File: /ngts/PAOPhot2/megafits/REF_IMAGE_80720230914233745/TIC-100504488_REF_IMAGE_80720230914233745_PHOT.fits
# Aper: 3.0
# Bin width: 10 minutes
# Columns:
#   BJD         : Barycentric Julian Date when the exposure was taken.
#   Flux        : Flux in target aperture from differential photometry.
#   FluxErr     : Error in target flux from differential photometry.
#   FluxComp    : Flux from master comparison star used to perform differential photometry.
#   FluxNorm    : Flux normalised by the median across the full dataset.
#   FluxNormErr : Error in the flux normalised by the median across the full dataset.
#   FluxRaw     : Raw flux from target.
#   FluxRawErr  : Error in raw flux from target.
#   FluxBkg     : Raw background flux.
#   Night       : Observation night in format YYYY-MM-DD.
#   Airmass     : Airmass value at the time the exposure was taken.
#   CameraID    : ID of NGTS camera that took the exposure.
#   ActionID    : ID of NGTS 'action' to observe a specific ra/dec on a given night with a specific telescope.
#   ImageID     : ID of the image taken for a given exposure.
#   ZeroPoint   : SYSREM zero point of the image - not a true photometric zero point
#   SigmaXS     : SYSREM Sigma XS value of the image - used to flag cloudy data.
#   Trend_Airmass                         : Global ensemble fitted normalized trend.
#   FluxNormDetrended_Airmass             : Global ensemble trend-corrected normalized flux.
#   FluxNormErrDetrended_Airmass          : Global ensemble trend-corrected normalized flux error.
#   Trend_FluxBkg                         : Global ensemble fitted normalized trend.

#   FluxNormErrDetrended_FluxBkg          : Global ensemble trend-corrected normalized flux error.
